records.title: The Use of Multi-Scale Fiducial Markers To Aid Takeoff and Landing Navigation by Rotorcraft
records.publication_status: 正式会议论文：AIAA SCITECH 2024 Forum；全文阅读arXiv 2309.08769v3（预印本初版2023）
records.score_reason: rotorcraft takeoff/landing, nested multiscale markers, outdoor pose and availability evaluation
claims: Evaluates nested (3 tags at scales 1:4:30) and non-nested (20 tags, 1:5:28) AprilTag layouts with WOLF binocular SLAM.
Reports ATE and estimated-pose fraction; marker-only and marker+feature modes did not show clear differences on this dataset.
author_limitations: All 10–50 Lux sequences failed; low runway texture and markers leaving view limit tracking (§5).
RTK takeoff/landing position mismatch limits rigorous interpretation of ATE (§5).
Layout-aware PnP and IMU integration are future work (§6).
our_inference: Cannot claim adding texture always improves accuracy/availability; our texture lives on known target unlike generic scene-feature SLAM.

records.title: Recursive ArUco Markers: A Scalable Fiducial Marker Design for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Landing Pads
records.publication_status: formal JSAN 15(5):70, 2026-08-24 (parent verified); full text read arXiv
records.score_reason: direct multiscale and partial-visible UAV marker competitor
claims: Embeds same-ID submarkers in both black and white cells; border sampling makes decoding independent of cell-center content.
Evaluates simulated distance/view angle, random occlusion, cropping, motion blur and a DJI flight sequence.
author_limitations: HArCo and Embedded ArUco not empirical baselines because source/executables unavailable (§4).
Flight sequence has no detection before takeoff, intermittent loss above about 14 m and final camera pitch loss (§4.5).
our_inference: Reported cropped/occluded detection means decoding any hierarchical ID; it is not a pose-accuracy or successful autonomous-landing metric.
State5 center-only mechanism cannot be sold as general solution to arbitrary occlusion.

records.title: Flexible Layouts for Fiducial Tags
records.score_reason: original flexible/nested tags applied to quadrotor; foundational for Lee
claims: Supports custom layouts with an empty center for smaller recursive tags.
Demonstrates a 90.2 cm doubly nested tag detected from 0.08 to 16.15±0.03 m with 640×480 onboard images (§IV-A).
author_limitations: Detection speed and recall trade off through decimation (§IV-C).
our_inference: Detection-range demonstration is not proof of equivalent pose accuracy at all ranges.
Known-size outer/inner center-switching predates our five-state schedule.

records.title: A hierarchical vision-based localization of rotor unmanned aerial vehicles for autonomous landing
records.publication_status: formal International Journal of Distributed Sensor Networks 14(9)
records.score_reason: direct adaptive feature selection over approach/adjust/touchdown and pose failure handling
locations: A hierarchical vision-based localization framework / Hierarchical localization
claims: Far approach uses external four-vertex contour; adjustment uses artificial fiducial corners; close touchdown uses Harris+Lucas–Kanade temporal homography accumulation.
Switches considering height and object projection ratio; detects orientation outliers using camera–inertial relative rotation and a median/3σ rule.
author_limitations: Touchdown accumulation argued acceptable for short duration; filtering three phase measurements is future work.
Reference GPS/INS typical position accuracy <1 m horizontal / <2 m vertical, given in Field experiment.
our_inference: Our scale-driven feature strategy and pose-failure check are not first in general.
Distinction must be same-template raw observations, intraframe fallback and geometrically tied region use; no claim based on state count.

records.title: Autonomous Landing of Quadrotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Based on Multi-Level Marker and Linear Active Disturbance Reject Control
records.score_reason: recent multilayer ArUco+EPnP+fusion UAV-USV direct comparison
claims: Largest marker → multiple visible markers → smallest marker three-stage approach.
Each marker estimates pose; positions from visible markers are averaged (Eq6) then Kalman-filtered.
30 ground landing experiments compare single/multilevel landing accuracy.
author_limitations: Complex USV motion and wave impact compensation listed as future work.
our_inference: Position-level averaging differs from our unified-coordinate raw 2D/3D joint PnP.
Landing error includes controller effects; not interchangeable with framewise pose error.

records.title: Embedded ArUco: a novel approach for high precision UAV landing
records.publication_status: formal SIBCON2021 pp1–6; DOI printed in author PDF
records.score_reason: outer loss followed by inner-center marker is direct antecedent to State5
claims: Inner marker replaces a central black encoding cell; inner/outer use different IDs.
Landing switches to inner marker when outer is outside frame; tested 20 Gazebo landings.
author_limitations: Outer ID must have black central cell; recommends inner marker with more black than white cells (§IV-A).
our_inference: Center-only recovery already exists; our contribution must reside in observation-family fallback and common target geometry, with real-data evidence.

records.title: A Precision Drone Landing System using Visual and IR Fiducial Markers and a Multi-Payload Camera
records.publication_status: arXiv version read; formal venue not verified
records.score_reason: long-range visual/IR, nested targets and detection-loss recovery; avoids six-DOF unlike our task
claims: Controls primarily from direction, apparent marker size and zoom; deliberately avoids full 6-DOF fiducial pose.
Uses three concentric AprilTags for RGB tests and a high-level search/reacquisition policy.
26 landing tests, including visual and active/passive IR, report final landing error.
author_limitations: Passive IR may depend on weather and reflect drone heat; more tests required (§IV).
Moving pads, other weather/backgrounds are future work (§V).
our_inference: Reacquiring via camera/aircraft motion differs from intraframe observation fallback; final landing error is not pose RMSE.

records.title: Fractal Markers: A New Approach for Long-Range Marker Pose Estimation Under Occlusion
records.score_reason: direct multiscale planar marker and observation fallback antecedent
claims: Nested square markers share a common reference origin; initial detected outer corners seed projection/refinement of other visible internal corners and pose is re-estimated from the combined set.
When no complete marker is detected, prior detection seeds FAST corner classification and RANSAC matching before refinement.
With temporal prior, partial-visible recovery does not require current full-marker decoding.
author_limitations: Keypoint association assumes interframe motion is not very large (§IV-D).
Higher occlusion increases error (§V-E); multiple distinct Fractal markers suggested as future work (§VI).
our_inference: RArUco2026 center-dependence characterization cannot be transferred wholesale to Fractal's temporal fallback; distinguish initialization decoding vs tracking.
Our generic contour+texture families differ, but 'unified 3D coordinates/internal+external points' and 'remaining observation recovery' alone are established.

synthesis.critical_prior_art: Fractal2019在统一标记坐标系下联合内部/外部可见角点求位姿；无完整标记检出时可由上一帧检测引导FAST角点类型分类与RANSAC恢复。须区分无历史冷启动解码和有历史跟踪。RArUco2026对Fractal中心依赖的概括不能代替Fractal原文。
contribution_boundaries: 多尺度、分级标记、外框丢失后内层定位并非本文首次。
由高度/投影比例切换特征或定位策略已有Yuan2018先例。
本文可着重具体任务的五状态调度、轮廓与纹理共同坐标建模、同帧求解失败后的策略降级；创新强度须由消融验证。
不能泛化宣称特征融合必然提升定位：Lee2024对其跑道数据未见明确改进。
PnP观测精度、系统定位精度和最终闭环着陆误差须分开叙述。
synthesis.access_notes: 公开作者/机构/出版社全文优先。无法全文读取的记录仅使用实际可见摘要、索引章节或元数据；没有以未读全文推断方法缺少某机制。
